headlines.title: Visa获批在华筹备银行卡清算机构
headlines.summary: 今天（13日），中国人民银行公示，批准威士公司（VISA在我国境内成立的企业法人，为外商投资企业）筹备银行卡清算机构。这次获批，只是拿到“筹备资格”，不等于可以直接开展业务。拿到筹备资格后，按照监管要求，威士公司需要在1年之内完成全部筹备工作，准备妥当后，再提交开业申请。这份申请需要央行和国家金融监管总局共同审核，审核通过，下发银行卡清算业务许可证，才算拿到正式许可。在拿到最终许可证之前，Visa不能在境内发行Visa品牌人民币银行卡，也无法为境内主体提供人民币银行卡清算服务。

headlines.title_en: Visa approved to prepare bank card clearing institution in China
headlines.summary_en: Today (the 13th), the People's Bank of China announced that it has approved Visa Inc. (a corporate legal person established in China by Visa, as a foreign-invested enterprise) to prepare a bank card clearing institution. This approval only grants "preparation qualification" and does not mean it can directly conduct business. After obtaining preparation qualification, in accordance with regulatory requirements, Visa Inc. must complete all preparatory work within one year, and after preparations are complete, submit an application to commence operations. This application must be reviewed jointly by the PBOC and the National Financial Regulatory Administration, and only after approval is granted and a bank card clearing business license is issued will it have obtained formal permission. Before obtaining the final license, Visa cannot issue Visa-branded RMB bank cards within China, nor can it provide RMB bank card clearing services to domestic entities.

headlines.title: 中国央行批准威士公司筹备银行卡清算机构
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行10月13日对外公布，向威士信息技术（北京）有限公司下发准予行政许可决定，批准其筹备银行卡清算机构。后续，威士公司需在一年内完成筹备工作，之后可提交开业申请，中国人民银行会同金融监管总局审批同意后，颁发银行卡清算业务许可证。据介绍，威士信息技术（北京）有限公司是维萨公司在我国境内成立的企业法人，为外商投资企业。

headlines.title_en: PBOC approves Visa to prepare bank card clearing institution
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China announced on October 13 that it issued an administrative licensing decision to Visa Information Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd., approving it to prepare a bank card clearing institution. Subsequently, Visa Inc. must complete preparatory work within one year, after which it may submit an application to commence operations. After the People's Bank of China, together with the National Financial Regulatory Administration, approves it, a bank card clearing business license will be issued. According to the introduction, Visa Information Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. is a corporate legal person established in China by Visa Inc. and is a foreign-invested enterprise.

headlines.title_en: Financial opening-up stepped up further! Visa approved to prepare bank card clearing institution in China
headlines.summary_en: Today (the 13th), the People's Bank of China announced that it has approved Visa Inc. (a corporate legal person established in China by Visa, as a foreign-invested enterprise) to prepare a bank card clearing institution. What does approval to prepare mean? Many people seeing the news may think Visa will soon be able to conduct RMB bank card business in China, but it is actually not that simple. This approval only grants "preparation qualification" and does not mean it can directly conduct business. After obtaining preparation qualification, in accordance with regulatory requirements, Visa Inc. must complete all preparatory work within one year, and after preparations are complete, submit an application to commence operations. This application must be reviewed jointly by the PBOC and the National Financial Regulatory Administration, and only after approval is granted and a bank card clearing business license is issued will it have obtained formal permission. Before obtaining the final license, Visa cannot issue Visa-branded RMB bank cards within China, nor can it provide services to domestic entities.

headlines.title: 澳大利亚联储11月会议仍存加息可能，CBA称政策信号明显偏鹰
headlines.summary: 澳大利亚联邦银行（CBA）经济学家贝琳达·艾伦表示，澳洲联储11月政策会议“仍存在很大悬念”。艾伦表示，CBA目前仍认为澳联储不会加息，但承认判断失误的风险较高。她指出，近期澳联储官员的表态“明显偏向鹰派”，政策重点放在通胀上行风险上，而对经济增长下行风险的关注较少。艾伦表示，澳联储近期沟通释放出的信号表明，央行仍然担忧通胀压力持续存在，并可能需要保持更加谨慎的政策立场。

headlines.title_en: RBA still has room to hike rates at its November meeting, CBA says policy signals are clearly hawkish
headlines.summary_en: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) economist Belinda Allen said the RBA's November policy meeting "still remains highly uncertain." Allen said CBA currently still believes the RBA will not raise rates, but acknowledges that the risk of misjudgment is high. She noted that recent remarks by RBA officials have been "clearly hawkish," with policy focus on upside inflation risks and less attention to downside growth risks. Allen said signals from the RBA's recent communications indicate that the central bank remains concerned about persistent inflationary pressure and may need to maintain a more cautious policy stance.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China's total services imports and exports reached 5,070.16 billion yuan in January-August, up 7.9% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The head of the Department of Trade in Services and Commercial Services of the Ministry of Commerce introduced the development of trade in services from January to August 2026. From January to August 2026, China's total trade in services imports and exports reached 5,070.16 billion yuan (RMB, same below), up 7.9% year on year. Among this, exports were 1,999.61 billion yuan, up 14.8%; imports were 3,070.55 billion yuan, up 3.8%. The trade in services deficit was 1,070.94 billion yuan, narrowing by 145.12 billion yuan year on year. Knowledge-intensive services accounted for more than half of service exports. From January to August, imports and exports of knowledge-intensive services totaled 2,231.4 billion yuan, up 6.6%, accounting for 44% of total trade in services imports and exports. Exports of knowledge-intensive services were 1,074.47 billion yuan, up 10.9%, accounting for 53.7% of service exports; among them, personal culture and entertainment services and financial services grew fastest, with growth rates of 66% and 21.6%, respectively.

headlines.title: IMF首席经济学家邓雷罗：决策者应采取更具限制性的货币政策，以使通胀回到目标水平
headlines.summary: IMF首席经济学家邓雷罗：决策者应采取更具限制性的货币政策，以使通胀回到目标水平。 总体而言，高负债国家应该开始进行财政整顿以削减赤字。 亚洲是增长最快的地区，受益于AI热潮。 中国和印度是经济增长的主要引擎，其他国家也受益于AI需求。 英国在G7国家中表现较突出，因其已开始财政整顿，英国应继续坚持削减财政赤字的路线。

headlines.summary_en: IMF Chief Economist Gourinchas: Policymakers should adopt more restrictive monetary policy to bring inflation back to target levels. Overall, highly indebted countries should begin fiscal consolidation to reduce deficits. Asia is the fastest-growing region, benefiting from the AI boom. China and India are the main engines of economic growth, and other countries also benefit from AI demand. The UK stands out among G7 countries because it has begun fiscal consolidation, and the UK should continue to adhere to the path of reducing fiscal deficits.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai urban tourism 15th Five-Year Plan released: tourism revenue to strive to exceed 900 billion yuan by 2030
headlines.summary_en: At the Shanghai municipal government press conference in the "Starting the 15th Five-Year Plan" series of thematic events, Zhao Yong, Party Secretary and Director of the Shanghai Municipal Administration of Culture and Tourism, introduced the newly issued and implemented "Shanghai Urban Tourism Innovation Development 15th Five-Year Plan." The Plan anchors three major goals: building China's first stop for inbound tourism, China's preferred destination for urban tourism, and a demonstration zone for deep integration of culture and tourism. It proposes that by 2030 Shanghai's tourism revenue strive to exceed 900 billion yuan, inbound tourists reach more than 10 million person-times, and the added value of the tourism industry account for 5% of the city's GDP, striving to rank among the first tier of global tourism.

headlines.title: 何立峰会见美中关系全国委员会负责人
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰12日在钓鱼台国宾馆会见美中关系全国委员会董事会执行副主席格林伯格一行时表示，习近平主席不久前对美国进行国事访问，两国元首同意构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系”。中美双方应共同落实好两国元首重要共识，为中美经贸合作与世界经济注入更多确定性和稳定性。希望美中关系全国委员会为推动中美经济合作继续发挥积极作用。美方表示，美中关系稳定发展十分重要，愿继续发挥纽带作用，推动双方加强经济交流合作。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: He Lifeng meets with head of the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations
headlines.summary_en: He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met on the 12th at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse with a delegation led by Greenberg, Executive Vice Chairman of the Board of the National Committee on United States-China Relations. He said that President Xi Jinping recently paid a state visit to the United States, and the two heads of state agreed to build a "constructive China-US strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity." China and the United States should jointly implement the important consensus of the two heads of state and inject more certainty and stability into China-US economic and trade cooperation and the world economy. He expressed the hope that the National Committee on United States-China Relations will continue to play a positive role in promoting China-US economic cooperation. The US side said that the stable development of US-China relations is very important and that it is willing to continue to serve as a bridge and promote stronger economic exchanges and cooperation between the two sides. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title_en: Release of the Mineral Resources Catalog: China's mineral resources are divided into 4 categories, specifying 174 existing minerals and 119 sub-minerals
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources, together with the National Development and Reform Commission, today released the Mineral Resources Catalog, further clarifying the number of mineral types in China, which will become the foundational basis for China's mineral resource planning. The Mineral Resources Catalog released this time was optimized and adjusted based on the original Detailed Classification of Mineral Resources, dividing China's mineral resources into 4 categories: energy minerals, metal minerals, non-metallic minerals, and water and gas minerals, and clarifying that China currently has a total of 174 mineral species and 119 sub-species.

headlines.title_en: Head of the Department of Trade in Services and Commercial Services of the Ministry of Commerce introduces the development of trade in services in January-August 2026
headlines.summary_en: From January to August 2026, China's total trade in services imports and exports reached 5,070.16 billion yuan (RMB, same below), up 7.9% year on year. Among this, exports were 1,999.61 billion yuan, up 14.8%; imports were 3,070.55 billion yuan, up 3.8%. The trade in services deficit was 1,070.94 billion yuan, narrowing by 145.12 billion yuan year on year. It mainly showed the following characteristics: travel and transport service exports contributed nearly 50% to overall service export growth.
